PROCEDURES NOTE

Transcatheter aortic valve replacement was performed for severe native aortic stenosis via
transfemoral approach. The self-expanding platform was chosen given a large native annulus.

Valve: R34mm

Deployment was achieved in satisfactory position under rapid pacing with no more than mild
paravalvular regurgitation on final assessment. Peak/mean gradients of 14/6 mmHg were
recorded on predischarge echocardiography, with an effective orifice area of 2.5 cm2.
